title: Geodesics
description: In curved spacetime a falling body takes the straightest path there is - a geodesic. Gravity is not a force; it is the shape of the road. Unlocks the Geodesic Compass.

puzzle.goal: A mass M is squeezed until light cannot escape it. Write the radius r at which that happens, from gravity's constant G and the speed of light c.
puzzle.name: Schwarzschild radius
puzzle.ask: Find r in kilometres for the Sun: M = 1.989e30 kg, G = 6.674e-11, c = 2.998e8 m/s.
puzzle.method: Where the escape speed √(2GM/r) reaches c - which, by luck, is exactly what general relativity gives too.
